sn35.228:1.1: “Bhikkhus, the uninstructed worldling speaks of ‘the ocean, the ocean.’
sn35.228:1.2: But that is not the ocean in the Noble One’s Discipline;
sn35.228:1.3: that is only a great mass of water, a great expanse of water.
sn35.228:1.4: “The eye, bhikkhus, is the ocean for a person;
sn35.228:2.1: One who withstands that current consisting of forms is said to have crossed the ocean of the eye with its waves, whirlpools, sharks, and demons.
sn35.228:2.2: Crossed over, gone beyond, the brahmin stands on high ground.
sn35.228:2.3: “The ear, bhikkhus, is the ocean for a person….
sn35.228:2.7: The mind is the ocean for a person;
sn35.228:2.8: its current consists of mental phenomena.
sn35.228:2.9: One who withstands that current consisting of mental phenomena is said to have crossed the ocean of the mind with its waves, whirlpools, sharks, and demons.
sn35.228:2.10: Crossed over, gone beyond, the brahmin stands on high ground.”
sn35.228:2.11: This is what the Blessed One said. Having said this,
sn35.228:2.12: the Fortunate One, the Teacher, further said this:
sn35.228:3.1: “One who has crossed this ocean so hard to cross,
sn35.228:3.2: With its dangers of sharks, demons, waves,
sn35.228:3.3:
The knowledge-master who has lived the holy life,
Reached the world’s end,
